purpose: Draws a role's work place by its name, with what it is and where, or says plainly when the name is not known.
namedChanges: The imports: the catalogue client is `geo-catalogue`, the kind line is `place-hit-details`.

A name that is not known is said (F10). GilbApp's `PlaceName` swallowed a failed read (`.catch(() => undefined)`) and, with no label, drew nothing at all, so a stored place looked "not set". Now "A place" and a line that tells a 404, a failed read and an address outside the catalogue apart.

`PlaceName` and `NO_PLACE` of `EmploymentCard.tsx` are a unit of their own, named `WorkPlaceName` and exported (GilbApp: private to the card), because the card of this library draws the place only through a slot.
No other code changed; the `data-testid`s are GilbApp's.
